revision_summary: Two minor quote-timestamp errors must be corrected: (1) 'because her her electric bill has just been exorbitant' is at [01:15], not [01:08] — fix in both bill_anchor_audit.bill_ts and interest_reason_audit.reason_ts. (2) '02:30? K. Sounds good.' is at [03:47], not [02:12] — fix script_coverage[11].appointment_set customer_quote timestamp (note ts field already correctly shows 02:12 for the rep's opening ask, but the customer_quote is misattributed to that same ts when it actually occurs later at 03:47). Additionally: (a) add a top-level caveat noting the transcript's speaker-role labels are swapped (the 'rep' field contains the customer Ella's disclosures; the 'customer' field contains the ION agent's lines) — this is caught in prose but should be a structural flag given how much it could confuse a fast-reading manager; (b) surface the missed moment at 01:21 where the customer explicitly requested an IN-PERSON visit ('schedule someone to come and meet me... I don't drive') that the rep silently converted to a phone appointment without confirming the switch with her — this belongs in cherry_pick_moments and the handoff_brief's unresolved_concerns; (c) add a brief contextual note to the script_coverage block (not just buried in individual audits) explaining that the 8 'not_reached' sections reflect this being a reschedule of an already-qualified appointment, to prevent a manager from misreading this as a Verify-completion failure.
